dedupe_keys.name: usda ers agricultural exchange rate data set

description: The Agricultural Exchange Rate Data Set holds annual and monthly nominal and real exchange rates for 79 countries and the European Union that matter to US agriculture, together with real trade-weighted exchange rate indexes for many commodities and aggregations, reflecting that the trading partners that matter differ by commodity. It is produced by the Agricultural Exchange Rate model of the USDA Economic Research Service, with the International Monetary Fund among its primary data sources. Coverage runs from the beginning of 1970 to the latest available data. The files are available free as XLSX and CSV downloads, released quarterly; the page was updated on 27 August 2026 with the next update due on 19 November 2026. Caveats: indexes depend on the trade weights chosen by ERS, and real rates rely on price deflators that are revised. For simulation it provides commodity-specific currency indexes to model how exchange rate shocks change the competitiveness of US farm exports and the flow of agricultural trade, useful in resilience studies of food supply chains. It is related to the USDA WASDE record in this catalogue.
